subject.title: improve(agents): normalized web_search output contract with boundary-owned wrapping

question: Should the core `web_search` contract preserve provider-specific follow-up metadata such as Parallel `sessionId`, or should maintainers approve a new provider-agnostic continuation contract and migration for the documented workflows?
rationale: This is a public tool-result and plugin/provider compatibility choice: preserving the old fields conflicts with the stated closed generic union, while removing them breaks documented behavior. The implementation cannot safely choose the permanent contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define a compatible continuation seam
options.body: Add a documented provider-agnostic continuation capability that retains Parallel follow-up behavior, migrate the provider docs and tests, and prove it with a live provider run.

options.title: Preserve documented metadata
options.body: Keep the currently documented provider metadata in a compatible output shape and defer the closed-union redesign until a generic replacement is agreed.

options.title: Narrow this PR to schema hints
options.body: Leave runtime payloads unchanged and limit this PR to an output-schema hint that accurately describes the existing result contract.

recommendation.title: Define a compatible continuation seam
recommendation.body: Add a documented provider-agnostic continuation capability that retains Parallel follow-up behavior, migrate the provider docs and tests, and prove it with a live provider run.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged wave-1 contract work and this branch place this person closest to the output-contract design, while the final public compatibility decision remains a maintainer choice.
